levelInfo.title: Beginner
levelInfo.description: Build a foundation in using computers, the internet, and everyday digital tools.
benefits: Access essential learning content to build your basic knowledge and skills.
Earn your Beginner Badge after completing your first level.
Access essential services designed for new users.
Track your learning progress and monitor your achievements.
services: Basic Service Registration — Register and manage basic services available to new users.
Learning Resource Access — Access essential learning materials for your current level.
Progress Tracking — View your learning progress and current level status.

levelInfo.title: Explorer
levelInfo.description: Learn to recognize and defend against common cyber threats such as phishing, malware, and weak passwords.
benefits: Access advanced learning content to expand your knowledge and skills.
Earn your Explorer Badge by successfully completing Level 2.
Unlock additional services and opportunities available to Explorer members.
Access additional learning resources to support your continued development.
Track your progress and achievements as you advance through levels.
services: Advanced Service Registration — Register for additional services available to Level 2 users.
Learning Resource Library — Access a wider range of learning materials and resources.
Achievement Tracking — View your progress, badges, and completed achievements.

levelInfo.title: Advanced
levelInfo.description: Dive deeper into personal data management, privacy law (PDPA), and responsible data handling.
benefits: Access advanced learning resources designed to develop your expertise further.
Earn your Advanced Badge after successfully completing Level 3.
Unlock premium content available exclusively to Advanced members.
Receive priority access to selected services and opportunities.
Access exclusive learning materials for deeper knowledge and development.
services: Premium Service Access — Access premium services available exclusively to advanced users.
Advanced Resource Center — Explore advanced materials and specialized learning resources.
Priority Service Booking — Get priority access when booking selected services.

levelInfo.title: Expert
levelInfo.description: The top tier of the program, reached automatically after passing the Level 3 exam. No exam is required at this level.
benefits: Get full access to all services available across the platform.
Earn your Expert Badge as recognition of your highest achievement.
Unlock exclusive content designed for experienced and advanced users.
Receive priority support whenever you need assistance with our services.
Access expert-level learning resources to further develop your expertise.
Unlock exclusive services available only to Expert members.
services: Full Service Access — Access all services available across the CAMT Passport platform.
Exclusive Expert Services — Access specialized services designed specifically for Expert users.
Priority Support Service — Receive priority assistance and support when using the platform.
